summary: Amaze Holdings filed an 8-K on the October 15, 2026 securities purchase agreement with C/M Capital Master Fund, LP, creating a $100 million equity line (a US-style standby equity purchase facility) under which the company may sell newly issued common stock at its sole discretion over a 36-month term. Purchases are capped at $500,000 per Fixed Purchase and $10 million per day, priced at 95% of the lesser of the five-day VWAP or the lowest same-day sale price, contingent on an effective resale registration statement. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation; watch dilution and pricing overhang.
